description: This file implements a security reminder hook for the Claude Code environment. It checks for security patterns in file edits, especially targeting GitHub Actions workflow files and potentially dangerous code patterns, issuing warnings and blocking execution if necessary.

methods.name: debug_log
methods.description: Appends a timestamped debug message to the log file.

methods.name: get_state_file
methods.description: Returns the session-specific state file path.

methods.name: cleanup_old_state_files
methods.description: Removes state files older than 30 days.

methods.name: load_state
methods.description: Loads the set of warnings already shown in the current session.

methods.name: save_state
methods.description: Saves the set of warnings shown in the current session.

methods.name: check_patterns
methods.description: Checks if the file path or content matches any security pattern, returning the rule name and reminder.

methods.name: extract_content_from_input
methods.description: Extracts relevant content from tool input based on the tool type.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates reading input, checking patterns, issuing warnings, and controlling flow.
